neighbours.label: the subject of a complement clause with no 'that' (zero complementizer), e.g. 'aware his words…', 'sure it was…'
fire: Dana is aware her decisions affect the whole team.
After the meeting he was sure it would rain again.
The coach was glad their effort finally paid off.
Everyone in town knew his shop would close soon.
Mara felt certain its value had doubled since spring.
The pilot was confident they could land before dark.
My neighbor is aware my dog barks at night.
We were relieved our flight had not been cancelled.
quiet: Dana is aware that her decisions affect the whole team.
After the meeting he was sure that it would rain again.
The coach was glad about their effort finally paying off.
Everyone in town knew about his shop closing soon.
Mara felt certain that its value had doubled since spring.
The pilot was confident that they could land before dark.
My neighbor is aware of my dog barking at night.
We were relieved that our flight had not been cancelled.

predictions: Fires on the pronoun/determiner opening a bare complement clause after aware/sure/glad/knew; quiet on the same clauses with an explicit 'that' and on 'aware of his…'.
